articles.title: Diplodocus, Long Thought Exclusively American, Turns Up in Spain
articles.zh: 一直被认为只存在于美洲的梁龙，在西班牙现身
articles.summary: 如果你做科普内容，这是个现成的"教科书被改写"选题——梁龙的分布地图要重画了
articles.body:
Paleontologists from Fundación Dinópolis have identified the first confirmed fossils of the genus Diplodocus found outside North America.

The Spanish Diplodocus was a close relative of Diplodocus hallorum . Image credit: Carmelo López.

“We are delighted with this discovery,” said Fundación Dinópolis Ph.D. student Sergio Sánchez Fenollosa.

“It allows us to better understand Iberian Mesozoic ecosystems and the diversity of sauropod dinosaurs that inhabited the European Jurassic.”

The Spanish Diplodocus lived roughly 150 million years ago near the end of the Jurassic period.

The dinosaur stretched an estimated 25 m (82 feet), on par with its American relatives.

The animal’s fossilized remains 14 well-preserved tail vertebrae and several chevron bones were unearthed at the La Tejería site near the city of El Castellar in the Spanish province of Teruel.

“The Diplodocus from El Castellar was approximately 25 m long, making it another of the giant sauropods of the Spanish Jurassic, alongside other sauropod dinosaurs from Teruel with characteristics very different from those of diplodocids, such as Turiasaurus and Losillasaurus , among others,” said Dr. Alberto Cobos, managing director of Fundación Dinópolis.

“It was an exciting and continuous process of seeing the pieces of the puzzle gradually fall into place.”

“From the early stages of the osteological study, we noticed strong similarities with several diplodocine sauropods.”

“As we looked more closely at the anatomy, we began to identify a combination of features characteristic of Diplodocus species.”

“Then, as we carried out different evolutionary analyses, they kept pointing in the same direction.”

“With each new result, the picture became clearer: we were looking at a Diplodocus .”

According to the team, the presence of Diplodocus in Iberia offers strong evidence that dinosaurs moved between North America and Europe during that era, likely crossing temporary land bridges that appeared as the proto-North Atlantic Ocean periodically receded.

“The outcome of the dig is some of the strongest paleontological evidence for episodes of dispersal and faunal exchange between the two continents across the proto-Atlantic Ocean during the Late Jurassic,” Sánchez Fenollosa said.

“The fossils of all these dinosaurs, including those of the new Diplodocus specimen, make Teruel a reference place for understanding this great diversity.”

The team’s paper will be published in the Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology .

Sergio Sánchez Fenollosa et al . 2026. Intercontinental evidence of the iconic genus Diplodocus Marsh, 1878 (Dinosauria, Sauropoda). Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology , in press; doi: 10.1080/02724634.2026.2718423
articles.bodyZh:
迪诺波利斯基金会（Fundación Dinópolis）的古生物学家（paleontologists）确认，他们找到了北美以外第一批被证实属于梁龙属（Diplodocus）的化石。

西班牙这只梁龙，是梁龙霍尔龙（Diplodocus hallorum）的近亲。图片：卡梅洛·洛佩斯（Carmelo López）。

迪诺波利斯基金会的博士生塞尔希奥·桑切斯·费诺略萨（Sergio Sánchez Fenollosa）说：“这个发现让我们特别高兴。”

“它让我们能更好地了解伊比利亚（Iberian）中生代（Mesozoic）的生态系统，也能看清欧洲侏罗纪（Jurassic）里生活的蜥脚类恐龙（sauropod dinosaurs）到底有多丰富。”

这只西班牙梁龙生活在大概1.5亿年前，也就是侏罗纪快结束的时候。

它身长估计有25米（82英尺），和它在美洲的亲戚个头差不多。

这次挖到的化石包括14节保存得不错的尾椎骨（tail vertebrae），还有几块人字骨（chevron bones，尾巴下面那种V形小骨头），地点在西班牙特鲁埃尔省（Teruel）埃尔卡斯特利亚尔市（El Castellar）附近的拉特赫里亚（La Tejería）遗址。

迪诺波利斯基金会总经理阿尔韦托·科博斯博士（Dr. Alberto Cobos）说：“来自埃尔卡斯特利亚尔的这只梁龙大约有25米长，是西班牙侏罗纪的巨型蜥脚类恐龙之一。跟它一起的，还有特鲁埃尔出土的其他蜥脚类恐龙，比如图里亚龙（Turiasaurus）和洛西利亚龙（Losillasaurus）等；这些恐龙的特征跟梁龙类（diplodocids）很不一样。”

“整个过程特别带劲，就像看着拼图一块块慢慢拼到位。”

“从骨骼学研究（osteological study）刚一开始，我们就发现它跟好几种梁龙亚科蜥脚类（diplodocine sauropods）很像。”

“等我们更仔细地看它的解剖结构，就开始辨认出一组梁龙属物种才有的特征组合。”

“后来我们做了各种演化分析（evolutionary analyses），结果也一直指向同一个方向。”

“每多一个新结果，画面就更清楚一点：我们看的这就是一只梁龙。”

研究团队说，梁龙出现在伊比利亚，强有力地说明那个时代恐龙曾在北美和欧洲之间来回跑，很可能是趁着原北大西洋（proto-North Atlantic Ocean）周期性地退去、露出来的临时陆桥（land bridges）过去的。

桑切斯·费诺略萨说：“这次发掘的结果，是证明晚侏罗世（Late Jurassic）两个大陆隔着原大西洋发生扩散和动物群交流（faunal exchange）的最有力古生物学证据之一。”

“所有这些恐龙的化石，包括这次新发现的梁龙标本，都让特鲁埃尔成了理解这种巨大多样性的一个标杆地点。”

团队的论文会发表在《古脊椎动物学杂志》（Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology）上。

塞尔希奥·桑切斯·费诺略萨等，2026年。标志性梁龙属（Diplodocus Marsh, 1878）（恐龙类 Dinosauria，蜥脚类 Sauropoda）的洲际证据。《古脊椎动物学杂志》（Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology），即将出版；doi: 10.1080/02724634.2026.2718423

articles.title: CCC invites all model citizens to 40C3
articles.zh: CCC 邀请所有"模型公民"参加 40C3
articles.summary: 如果你在欧洲或者关注开源社区，CCC年度大会今年把AI从业者单独圈了出来，投稿和参会信息可以看看
articles.body:
The word is on the street: the Chaos Computer Club is hosting 40C3 from 27 to 30 December 2026 – Europe’s biggest hacker party, conference and platform for technology, society and civil liberties. We understand the Congress to be a huge shared stage and therefore invite you to help shape it. The Call for Participation for talks, the entertainment programme, art, punk and music opens today.

Everything is getting bigger, more colourful and more beautiful. Following our moving to the Hamburg Exhibition halls , there is once again plenty of space for creative ideas. Obviously, we want to make the most of this new space, which is why we are inviting all galactic beings to the 40th Chaos Communication Congress from 27 to 30 December 2026.

With the idea of this year’s motto ‘Model Citizens’ in mind, we want to work together to find new models for society, now that the ‘Model Citizens’ of the past have left the planet in a precarious state. There are loads of ways to go about this. For example, the Congress is the biggest non-commercial hacker conference, organised by volunteers, supported by thousands of unpaid helpers and over 16,000 visitors who don’t just passively consume the event, but actively help to shape it.

Times have become harsher. The consensus that, in a democratic society, we should work in solidarity towards a shared, better future is increasingly giving way to the model of an authoritarian state, in which the stronger impose their views on the weaker. Personal commitment and a sense of responsibility are taking a back seat to the call for a strong hand that is supposed to make everything ‘great again’. The remaining liberal forces are fighting rearguard actions and no longer attempt to create something new, but merely to prevent things from getting worse.

We see things differently, with a more combative spirit: the Congress was and remains the model for how things can be different. Differences are seen as an asset, the unfamiliar as a source of inspiration, and mutual needs as an opportunity to create a sense of community in which everyone feels comfortable and welcome.

For our time-honoured lecture programme at 40C3, we are calling for speakers to respond to our Call for Content ; we are also reaching out to DJs and musicians to bring their talents to our lounge and party stages . Artists and designers can apply via our Call for Art with exhibits, sculptures and performances that do not require a stage. For our Punk-Späti, we’re looking for accomplices and fellow troublemakers for anarchic and anti-fascist performances in our usual warm yet rough-and-ready atmosphere.
articles.bodyZh:
街头巷尾都在传：混沌电脑俱乐部（Chaos Computer Club）将于2026年12月27日至30日举办第40届混沌通讯大会（40C3）——这可是欧洲最大的黑客派对、会议，也是探讨技术、社会与公民自由的平台。我们把这次大会看作一个巨大的共享舞台，因此邀请你来一起塑造它。演讲、娱乐节目、艺术、朋克和音乐的征稿今天正式开启。

一切都在变得更大、更丰富多彩、更美好。自从我们搬到汉堡展览中心之后，这里又有充足的空间容纳各种创意点子了。显然，我们想充分利用这个新场地，所以我们邀请所有银河系生命来参加2026年12月27日至30日的第40届混沌通讯大会。

想到今年“模范公民”（Model Citizens）这个主题，我们想一起为社会寻找新的模式——毕竟过去的那些“模范公民”已经把地球搞得一团糟了。实现这个目标的方式有很多。比如说，这次大会是最大的非商业黑客会议，由志愿者组织，有数千名无偿帮手和超过16000名参会者支持——他们不只是被动地消费这场活动，而是积极地参与塑造它。

时代变得越来越艰难了。在一个民主社会里，我们应该团结一致、共同迈向更美好未来——这个共识正在逐渐让位给威权国家的模式，强者把自己的观点强加给弱者。个人担当和责任感正在退居其次，取而代之的是呼唤一个“强有力的手”来让一切“再次伟大”。剩下的自由派力量在打后卫战，不再试图创造新事物，只是努力阻止情况变得更糟。

我们的看法不同，我们更有战斗精神：大会过去是、现在仍然是“事情可以不一样”的典范。差异被视为财富，陌生被视为灵感来源，彼此的需求被视为建立社区归属感的机会——在这个社区里，每个人都感到舒适和受欢迎。

对于40C3我们历史悠久的讲座项目，我们正在征集演讲者来响应我们的内容征集（Call for Content）；我们也在联系DJ和音乐人，邀请他们把自己的才华带到我们的休息区和派对舞台上。艺术家和设计师可以通过我们的艺术征集（Call for Art）来申请，提交不需要舞台的展品、雕塑和表演。至于我们的朋克深夜场（Punk-Späti），我们正在寻找同伙和捣蛋鬼，在我们一贯温暖又粗犷的氛围中进行无政府主义和反法西斯的表演。

articles.title: TSMC revealing details about next gen A14 node
articles.zh: 台积电披露下一代 A14 制程细节
articles.summary: 如果你关心明后年的算力从哪来，台积电A14的参数直接决定下一代AI硬件的能效天花板
articles.body:
IEEE IEDM 2026 Map Your Show

Monday, December 14 2:15 PM - 2:40 PM PST Grand Ballroom B Create or log in to My Show Planner to see Notes .

Your account does not have access to this session.

A14 NanoFlex TM Pro platform technology features the world’s smallest SRAM with a cell size <0.017μm 2 and highest SRAM macro density to date through dimensional ground rule scaling. Coupled with standard cell innovations, it delivers a full-node PPA improvement over the predecessor N2 technology for a 10~15% speed enhancement, a 25~30% power reduction and a chip density increase by ~20% driven by logic and SRAM scaling. Key features, such as TSV, innovative RDL that enables SoIC bond pitch of 4.5μm and high-performance MiM processes, have also been developed to accelerate the system-level integration and scaling for SoIC products. Supported by robust yield and device progress, A14 technology is on track for volume production in 2028.

Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC)
articles.bodyZh:
IEEE IEDM 2026 展会导览（Map Your Show）

12 月 14 日星期一，太平洋标准时间（PST）下午 2:15 - 2:40，大宴会厅 B（Grand Ballroom B）。创建或登录“我的展会规划器”（My Show Planner），就能查看笔记。

你的账号看不了这场会议。

A14 NanoFlex TM Pro 平台技术，靠着尺寸设计规则（dimensional ground rule）微缩，做出了全世界最小的 SRAM（静态随机存取存储器），单元面积不到 0.017 平方微米，而且 SRAM 宏密度（macro density）也是到目前为止最高的。再配上标准单元（standard cell）方面的创新，它相比上一代 N2 技术实现了全节点 PPA（性能、功耗、面积）提升：速度提高 10~15%，功耗降低 25~30%，芯片密度在逻辑和 SRAM 微缩带动下增加约 20%。另外还开发了一些关键特性，比如 TSV（硅通孔）、能把 SoIC（系统整合芯片）键合间距做到 4.5 微米的新型 RDL（重布线层），以及高性能 MiM（金属-绝缘体-金属）工艺，用来加快 SoIC 产品的系统级集成和微缩。有了稳健良率和器件进展撑腰，A14 技术预计会在 2028 年如期量产。

台积电（TSMC）

articles.title: Accelerating Sharded Data Parallelism at Scale with Federated Learning
articles.zh: 用联邦学习加速大规模分片数据并行
articles.summary: 如果你在做大规模分布式训练，这篇把联邦学习和分片数据并行结合，可能帮你省下一笔通信开销
articles.author: Gianluca Mittone, Marco Aldinucci
articles.body: The symbiotic scaling of artificial intelligence models and high-performance computing systems continually creates algorithmic challenges in their convergence. Foundation models (FMs) are a crucial example, requiring months-long training on thousands of cutting-edge GPUs. Sharded data parallelism (DP) is the dominant strategy to accelerate such computations by splitting data and models across multiple GPUs. However, it incurs prohibitive communication overhead when deployed at scale, particularly on multi-tier interconnects with heterogeneous performance. Inspired by the efficient communication principles of federated learning (FL), this work introduces two hybrid algorithms - FL+FSDP and FL+HSDP - interleaving sharded DP with FedAvg-style aggregations. Such approaches decouple large DP deployments into smaller, loosely-coupled federation groups, requiring minimal inter-group traffic while keeping the global batch size bounded by the groups' size. Formal analysis of communication costs and experimental validation prove their scalability and flexibility. A Llama3.1 8B pre-training on 512 A100 GPUs shows that, under identical hyperparameters, FL+FSDP and FL+HSDP achieve up to 8.04 faster data processing and 4.48 lower evaluation perplexity than their counterparts, demonstrating superior computational efficiency and improved model quality. These properties stem from reduced communication overhead and the bounded growth of the global batch size relative to the federation group size.
articles.bodyZh: 人工智能模型（artificial intelligence models）和高性能计算系统（high-performance computing systems）像是互相带动的共生体，它们越扩展、越融合（convergence），就越不断给算法挑战（algorithmic challenges）出难题。基础模型（Foundation Models，简称 FMs）就是个关键例子：它们得在成千上万块最先进的 GPU 上训练好几个月。分片数据并行（sharded data parallelism，DP）是目前加速这类计算的主流办法，靠的是把数据和模型切分到多块 GPU 上。但一旦大规模部署，它产生的通信开销会高得让人望而却步，尤其是在性能不均衡的多层互连（multi-tier interconnects）上。受联邦学习（federated learning，FL）高效通信原则的启发，这项研究提出了两种混合算法——FL+FSDP 和 FL+HSDP——把分片数据并行和 FedAvg 风格的聚合（FedAvg-style aggregations）交错结合起来。这类做法把大规模的数据并行部署拆成更小、松耦合的联邦组（federation groups），组间只需要很少的通信流量，同时让全局批量大小（global batch size）受各组规模约束，不会无限膨胀。对通信成本的形式化分析（formal analysis）和实验验证都证明，它们可扩展、也够灵活。在 512 块 A100 GPU 上预训练（pre-training）Llama3.1 8B 模型时，在超参数（hyperparameters）完全一样的情况下，FL+FSDP 和 FL+HSDP 比同类方案的数据处理速度快最多 8.04 倍，评测困惑度（evaluation perplexity）低最多 4.48，说明它们计算效率更高、模型质量也更好。这些好处来自通信开销降低了，以及全局批量大小相对于联邦组规模是有界增长（bounded growth）的。

articles.title: Generating Heterogeneous 3D Geological Microstructures from 2D Images via a Stable Diffusion-Adversarial Model
articles.zh: 基于Stable Diffusion-对抗模型从2D图像生成非均质3D地质微观结构
articles.summary: 如果你做地质建模或科学图像生成，这篇给了从2D切片还原3D微观结构的生成方案
articles.author: Ali Aouf, Eric Laloy 等

articles.title: A Qualitative Model for Reasoning about Path and Support
articles.zh: 一种关于路径与支撑的定性推理模型
articles.summary: 如果你关心符号推理和空间关系建模，这篇偏理论，给的是形式化框架而不是能直接跑的工具
articles.author: Abhishek Jaiswal, Zoe Falomir
articles.body: Spatial reasoning abilities correlate strongly with performance in STEM fields. Games offer a compelling medium for training these critical skills in developing children who have a natural proclivity for play. However, to facilitate human-like tutoring and player guidance, these games require an AI agent capable of making commonsense inferences from spatial events. Qualitative reasoning (QR) models appear to be a suitable framework for these application domains. As these models reason in symbolic representations, they can seamlessly translate game states into interpretable feedback for human-like player guidance. This paper introduces a hybrid qualitative model designed for Camelot Jr., a block-puzzle game that requires constructing multi-level bridges to connect two avatars stationed on separate towers. The game poses a challenge for the player, who must make platforms stable, plan their path, and ensure they use all the provided blocks. To handle the precise physics required by the domain, we integrate a mathematical center-of-mass stability logic to guide our qualitative solver. Our work facilitates spatial skill training in Camelot Jr. and contributes to the development of human-centric, explainable game-playing agents.
articles.bodyZh: 空间推理能力与STEM领域（科学、技术、工程和数学）的表现密切相关。游戏为培养儿童这些关键技能提供了一个吸引人的媒介，尤其是那些天生喜欢玩耍的孩子。然而，为了实现类似人类的辅导和玩家指导，这些游戏需要一个能够从空间事件中进行常识推理的AI智能体。定性推理（QR）模型似乎是这些应用领域的合适框架。由于这些模型以符号表示进行推理，它们可以将游戏状态无缝转换为可解释的反馈，以实现类似人类的玩家指导。本文介绍了一种为Camelot Jr.设计的混合定性模型，这是一款积木拼图游戏，需要建造多层桥梁来连接分别位于不同塔楼上的两个角色。这款游戏对玩家提出了挑战，玩家必须使平台稳定、规划路径，并确保使用所有提供的积木。为了处理该领域所需的精确物理计算，我们集成了一个数学质心稳定性逻辑来指导我们的定性求解器。我们的工作促进了Camelot Jr.中的空间技能训练，并有助于开发以人为本、可解释的游戏智能体。

articles.title: STR-Agent: An LLM-Driven Agent for QoS-Aware Routing in LEO Satellite Networks
articles.zh: STR-Agent：面向LEO卫星网络QoS感知路由的LLM驱动Agent
articles.summary: 如果你在找Agent的落地场景，这篇把LLM塞进卫星网络做路由决策，是个很少见的硬核方向
articles.author: Bowen Lu, Mugen Peng 等
articles.body: LEO satellite networks feature dynamic topologies, time-varying links, and diverse service requirements, which make conventional routing schemes difficult to support fine-grained quality-of-service (QoS) provisioning. Existing studies mainly optimize routing over network states with predefined objectives, but rarely address the practical challenge of translating unstructured natural-language service requests into adaptive routing decisions. To bridge this gap, we propose STR-Agent, an LLM-driven framework for QoS-aware routing in LEO satellite networks. The key innovation of STR-Agent lies in unifying intent perception, tool-based execution, experience accumulation, and reflection-based policy adaptation within a single agent architecture. Specifically, the Perception Module converts natural-language requests into structured routing semantics, while the Reflection Module dynamically adjusts the service-to-routing-policy mapping according to real-time congestion conditions and historical routing outcomes, rather than relying on a fixed routing objective. In addition, we develop a specialized perception model, and construct a domain-specific supervised fine-tuning dataset for LEO service understanding. Simulation results in a Walker-Delta constellation show that STR-Agent significantly outperforms conventional baselines: it reduces end-to-end delay by up to 60% compared with DQ-Dijkstra, improves average intent-understanding accuracy from 45.4% to 92.45% after supervised fine-tuning, and the Reflection Module further reduces the delay by 120 ms at 600 Mbps. These results demonstrate the potential of LLM-driven agent architectures to enable service-aware and adaptive QoS routing in future LEO satellite networks.
articles.bodyZh: LEO卫星网络（低轨卫星网络）的拓扑结构是动态变化的，链路时变，业务需求也五花八门，这就让传统的路由方案很难做到精细化的服务质量（QoS）保障。现有研究大多是在预设目标下对网络状态做路由优化，但很少有人去解决一个实际问题：怎么把用户用自然语言提出的需求，转化成自适应的路由决策。为了填补这个空白，我们提出了STR-Agent，一个由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的LEO卫星网络QoS感知路由框架。STR-Agent的核心创新在于，它把意图理解、工具化执行、经验积累和基于反思的策略调整，统一到了一个智能体架构里。具体来说，感知模块负责把自然语言请求转成结构化的路由语义，而反思模块则根据实时拥塞情况和历史路由结果，动态调整业务到路由策略的映射关系，而不是死守一个固定的路由目标。除此之外，我们还专门开发了一个感知模型，并构建了一个面向LEO业务理解的领域专用监督微调数据集。在Walker-Delta星座下的仿真结果表明，STR-Agent明显优于传统基线方案：跟DQ-Dijkstra相比，端到端时延最多降低了60%；经过监督微调后，平均意图理解准确率从45.4%提升到了92.45%；反思模块在600 Mbps负载下还能进一步把时延降低120毫秒。这些结果说明，LLM驱动的智能体架构，有潜力在未来LEO卫星网络中实现业务感知和自适应的QoS路由。

articles.title: Structured Four-Stage Legal Translation: From Natural-Language Traffic Rules to PROLOG
articles.zh: 结构化四阶段法律翻译：从自然语言交通规则到PROLOG
articles.summary: 如果你想把法规文本转成机器可推理的形式，这套四阶段流程可以当作合规自动化的参考模板
articles.author: May Myo Zin, Wachara Fungwacharakorn 等
articles.body: Traffic regulations are written for human interpretation and therefore rely on shared background knowledge and flexible phrasing, which inherently introduce ambiguity, context dependence, and semantic underspecification. These linguistic characteristics conflict with the precision required by computational reasoning engines such as Prolog, which demand explicit logical structure. This study evaluates two baseline translation approaches, Natural Language to Prolog ($NL\rightarrow Prolog$) and Logical English to Prolog ($LE\rightarrow Prolog$), and introduces a new reasoning-guided translation framework called Structured Four-Stage Legal Translation ($S4L\rightarrow Prolog$). The proposed S4L framework performs semantic role extraction, scene completion, logical mapping, and Prolog rule generation within a single guided prompt, enabling direct translation of raw traffic rules into executable logic without human intervention. A benchmark consisting of twenty real-world traffic rules was used to evaluate each approach in terms of syntactic validity, semantic correctness, and logical completeness. $S4L\rightarrow Prolog$ achieves the highest accuracy, correctly formalizing 75 percent of the rules, while $NL\rightarrow Prolog$ reaches 60 percent and $LE\rightarrow Prolog$ reaches 55 percent. Qualitative analysis further shows that S4L captures implicit causal relations, deontic modality, and exception structure more reliably than the baselines. These results demonstrate that structured reasoning prompts can substantially improve the reliability of natural-language-to-logic translation for legal and safety-critical applications.
articles.bodyZh: 交通法规本来就是写给人理解和解释的，所以得靠大家共有的背景知识和比较灵活的措辞，这就天然会带来歧义、依赖上下文、语义说不全这些问题。而这些语言特点，跟 Prolog 这类计算推理引擎（computational reasoning engines）要求的精确性正好冲突，因为它们需要明确的逻辑结构。这项研究评估了两种基线翻译方法，一种是自然语言转 Prolog（Natural Language to Prolog, NL→Prolog），另一种是逻辑英语转 Prolog（Logical English to Prolog, LE→Prolog），同时提出了一个新的、由推理引导的翻译框架，叫结构化四阶段法律翻译（Structured Four-Stage Legal Translation, S4L→Prolog）。这个 S4L 框架能在一条引导提示（guided prompt）里完成语义角色抽取（semantic role extraction）、场景补全（scene completion）、逻辑映射（logical mapping）和 Prolog 规则生成（Prolog rule generation），从而把原始交通规则直接翻译成可执行逻辑，不需要人工介入。研究用了一个包含二十条真实交通规则的基准测试（benchmark）来评估每种方法，评估指标包括句法有效性（syntactic validity）、语义正确性（semantic correctness）和逻辑完整性（logical completeness）。S4L→Prolog 准确率最高，能正确形式化 75% 的规则，NL→Prolog 达到 60%，LE→Prolog 达到 55%。定性分析还显示，S4L 比这些基线方法更能可靠地捕捉隐含因果关系、道义模态（deontic modality）和例外结构（exception structure）。这些结果表明，结构化推理提示能大幅提高法律和安全关键应用（safety-critical applications）里自然语言转逻辑的可靠性。

articles.title: NeuSOGA3D: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Explainable 3D Geometric Reconstruction
articles.zh: NeuSOGA3D：面向可解释3D几何重建的神经符号框架
articles.summary: 如果你需要3D重建结果能讲清"为什么这么建"，这条神经符号路线比纯黑箱模型更好解释
articles.author: Qingde Li, Qingqi Hong 等

articles.title: To Copy or Not to Copy: Controlling Speculative Decoding via Intrinsic Model Signals
articles.zh: 复制还是不复制：用模型内在信号控制投机解码
articles.summary: 如果你在优化LLM推理速度，这篇讲清了投机解码何时该接受草稿、何时该拒绝，能少踩坑
articles.author: Roy Eisenstadt, Ido Cohen 等
articles.body: Speculative Decoding (SD) has significantly accelerated Large Language Model (LLM) inference, yet existing approaches face a fundamental tradeoff between two drafting strategies: neural drafting and context-based copying. Neural drafts (e.g., EAGLE3) provide robust performance across diverse text settings, while copy-based methods achieve higher speedups in copy-intensive regimes by generating candidates faster and exploiting long repetition spans for near-perfect speculation. We analyze existing copy-based methods and find that they are prone to accidental repetitions where surface-level n-gram overlap does not reflect a structural intent to copy, leading to false-positive triggers that ultimately degrade throughput. We introduce SwitchSD, an adaptive framework that treats copying as a latent control signal of the LLM. By training lightweight probes on the target model's internal representations, SwitchSD identifies genuine copy-intent with high precision (AUC > 0.99). This allows the system to dynamically switch between neural drafting (e.g., EAGLE) and context-based copying. Our results across Llama and Qwen families demonstrate throughput gains of up to 15% over state-of-the-art baselines like EAGLE3, effectively turning copying from a noisy heuristic into a principled, model-aware decoding regime.
articles.bodyZh: 推测解码（Speculative Decoding，简称 SD）已经大幅加快了大语言模型（LLM）的推理速度，但现有方法面临一个根本性的取舍，涉及两种草稿策略：神经草稿和基于上下文的复制。神经草稿（比如 EAGLE3）在各种文本场景下表现稳定，而基于复制的方法在复制密集的场景中能实现更高的加速，因为它能更快地生成候选内容，并利用长重复片段实现近乎完美的推测。我们分析了现有的基于复制的方法，发现它们容易产生偶然重复——也就是表面上的 n-gram 重叠并不代表结构上有复制的意图——这会引发误报触发，最终拖累吞吐量。我们提出了 SwitchSD，这是一个自适应框架，把复制当作 LLM 的一种潜在控制信号。通过在目标模型的内部表征上训练轻量级探针，SwitchSD 能以高精度（AUC > 0.99）识别真正的复制意图。这样一来，系统就能在神经草稿（比如 EAGLE）和基于上下文的复制之间动态切换。我们在 Llama 和 Qwen 系列上的实验结果表明，相比 EAGLE3 等最先进的基线方法，吞吐量最高提升了 15%，从而有效地把复制从一种嘈杂的启发式手段转变为一种有原则、模型感知的解码机制。

articles.title: QUALS: Corpus Equilibrium for Universal Forecasting via Pattern Quantization and Learnability Synchronization
articles.zh: QUALS：通过模式量化与可学习性同步实现通用预测的语料均衡
articles.summary: 如果你做时间序列或通用预测，这篇从训练语料分布入手，思路可借鉴但泛化性还需自己验证
articles.author: Yujie Li, Zezhi Shao 等
articles.body: Ubiquitous time series data across diverse domains enables critical applications in areas such as transportation systems and power grids. Recently, training foundation models on massive datasets to achieve accurate zero-shot forecasting has emerged as a major research focus. However, current studies predominantly prioritize architectural innovations while insufficiently addressing data diversity, often relying on simple data sampling strategies that fail to manage complex data distributions effectively, leading to inefficient use of training data and suboptimal performance. To address this, we propose QUALS, a large-scale time series corpus equilibrium framework. QUALS significantly enhances data efficiency, i.e., enabling existing models to achieve superior performance using only a small fraction of the original training data. Specifically, QUALS operates through two core mechanisms. First, a pattern quantization framework systematically decodes heterogeneous patterns from mixed corpora via vector quantization and uniform binning. Second, a learnability synchronization framework calibrates sampling weights for heterogeneous patterns, bridging the optimization gap between simple and complex motifs to maximize overall training efficiency. Extensive benchmarks demonstrate that pre-training on QUALS consistently achieves superior zero-shot performance, even under substantially reduced training budgets.
articles.bodyZh: 现在，各个领域都在源源不断地产生时间序列数据（time series data），交通系统、电网这些关键场景都离不开它。最近，拿海量数据去训练基础模型（foundation models），让它能直接做准零样本预测（zero-shot forecasting），成了研究圈的一大热点。可眼下的研究，大多把劲儿使在模型结构创新上，对数据多样性（data diversity）却关注不够，往往用很简单的数据采样（data sampling）办法，处理不了复杂的数据分布（data distributions），结果训练数据没用好，效果也上不去。针对这个问题，我们提出了 QUALS，一个大规模时间序列语料库均衡框架（large-scale time series corpus equilibrium framework）。QUALS 能明显提升数据效率（data efficiency），也就是让现有模型只靠原训练数据的一小部分，就能拿到更好的表现。具体说，QUALS 有两个核心机制。第一，模式量化框架（pattern quantization framework）会通过向量量化（vector quantization）和均匀分箱（uniform binning），系统地从混合语料里解码出各种不同模式。第二，可学习性同步框架（learnability synchronization framework）会给不同模式校准采样权重（sampling weights），把简单模式和复杂模式之间的优化落差补上，让整体训练效率最大化。大量基准测试（benchmarks）也证明，用 QUALS 做预训练，哪怕训练预算（training budgets）砍掉一大截，零样本表现也始终更占优。
